description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

2-layer hand-built circuit, LayerNorm removed: head 0 averages digit one-hots over the 10 digit positions (histogram of counts), head 1 fetches the query digit, MLP 1 selects count[query] with ReLU(H_k+11Q_k-11), MLP 2 converts count to one-hot ones/tens logits via ReLU triangles gated by position.
Same 2-layer circuit as HistQueryCircuit-v1 but attention sharpness BIG=1 (score gap 1 instead of 20): histogram head, query-fetch head, count selection MLP, ReLU-triangle one-hot output.
